C9000146.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 146 (Positive metric entropy for the standard map.; papers: Positive Metric Entropy for the Standard Map at Large Parameters; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/146.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_MAIN_ENTROPY.statement: For the exact standard sine map f_k and normalized area m, h_m(f_k)>0 for every sufficiently large k (main:entropy). This downstream manuscript claim remains unverified.

C_CANCELLATION.statement: The near-full-rate two-wing cancellation event has probability at most C exp(-gamma n), uniformly in center, n, and sufficiently large M (can:theorem).

C_MATCHING.statement: A near-full-rate cancellation supplies linearly many increasing pairs of good indices with logarithmic scale discrepancy at most 3/5 (can:many-good and can:matching).

C_BRIDGE.statement: The fast-bridge weighted product estimate holds at arbitrary sufficiently large bridge lengths (bridge:theorem); it is not established by this local-scarcity mission.

C_DOUBLING.statement: For all sufficiently large parameters and every n>=1, e_n<=e_(2n)<=C e_n+C/n (scale:doubling).

C_LIMITS.statement: The dyadic selection and locally finite nonaffine-array measures have the compactness, stationarity, and terminal-integrability properties in scale:selection and scale:limits.

C_SHAPES.statement: The limiting nonaffine semimetrics satisfy shape:exclusions and the one-ray/two-ray/slow classification in shape:classification.

C_ENTROPY_BALANCE.statement: The capped-deficit balance has positive terminal value, strictly smaller terminal contribution, and nonpositive invariant remainder, yielding end:contradiction.

C_LOCAL_SCARCITY.statement: The exact statement can:local-scarcity holds with c=99/100 and matching discrepancy at most 3/5, uniformly in all central coordinates and unbounded selected indices.

C_SCARCITY_EXT.statement: The same uniform scarcity holds for each 2/3<c<1 and each matching discrepancy alpha>=0 with 2 alpha<3c-1, for actual sine-map orbits and unbounded selected indices.

C_PATH_JETS.statement: For fixed 2/3<=c<1, rescaled orbit derivatives through order nine and quotient derivatives through order eight have bounds independent of path length, under base good-index growth.

C_CHAIN_BOUND.statement: Every eighth-order Green inverse chain has exponent at most 8-15c-(1/8) sum_i(d_i-1), for 2/3<=c<1, d_i>=1, p_i>=1 and sum_i p_i=8; hence L_j^2 |D^8 R_j|<=C M^(8-15c) uniformly in j.

C_OPPOSITE_CASE.statement: After normalization by max(the quadratic phase-discrepancy coefficients,1/K), opposite-cosine cancellation cannot produce a polynomial identity.

C_SLOW_CASE.statement: A vanishing second phase slope leads either to an affine reciprocal, a fast secant, or a nonzero eighth-order remainder; none agrees with a degree-at-most-seven polynomial on positive measure.

C_COMPACT_EXTRACTION.statement: Hausdorff compactness and interpolation at eight limiting successful points convert positive-measure limits into the excluded analytic identities, and yield a uniform neighborhood width.

C_FORMAL_ALGEBRA.statement: For eight unrestricted real depths >=1 and real c>=2/3, the expanded inverse-chain exponent is at most 8-15c-(sum(depths)-8)/8; the four alternating quadratic equations have only the zero solution; the required error exponents are negative; no degree-at-most-seven real polynomial equals X^8. This is not a formalization of the full scarcity theorem.
